scope: One independent AI assessor; no other panel, assignment, participant review or prior outcome was inspected. Agreement with another assessor was not queried or inferred.

runtime_review.caller_replacement: Inspected actual caller_fixture_update success at actions 10 and 13, stable mounted instance/input hashes and callback intervals; post-update collapsed controls, reset preference/requested state and new caller title/subtitle/status are visible.
runtime_review.long_states: Both permitted and requested full-state sweep interval unions were recomputed and visually inspected top through bottom, including all eight supplied chapter pairs. Target-only iOS transition captures are not claimed as full-content proofs.
runtime_review.findings: Qualitative propositions are supported in supplied original state-eligible evidence. Strict native/pixel evaluation has no F cells. The documented Android leading-strip support gaps and source-b iOS surface-locator gaps remain U. No U is reclassified as a product defect or a pass.
limits: Representative scenarios only; no unexecuted Cartesian truth-table cases inferred.
No physical hit-area guarantee is inferred from AX geometry or Compose semantic activation.
No independent second assessor was used in schema validation; own request was supplied to both acceptance slots only to check schema and immutable facts.

Original PNGs were inspected through hash-labelled derived contact sheets; duplicate images retain original-index mappings. Their display scales vary. Boundary crops are auxiliary; their narrow-state status text can exceed the fixed crop cell and is judged from complete original-state sheets instead.

Independent reference images were inspected as top/bottom contact sheets, with full permitted reference images inspected for the shared complete chapter copy. Reference rasterization is not a pixel-perfect baseline.

source_review.files: Exact declared Swift and Kotlin production files in each anonymous capsule, plus exact approved Bridge.swift and ObserverBridge.kt; all evidence hashes checked.
source_review.findings: All source-only propositions supported by direct file inspection with original line evidence. Source configuration judgments do not certify rendered style or runtime identifier survival.
source_review.compatibility_limit: iOS14 API use was reviewed in source. No SDK, compiler, archive, link or legacy runtime was run or claimed.

failure_attributions: Empty: no supported strict F. Unknown observations and failed inspection-helper attempts are preserved separately.

inspection_attempts.result: Output too large and truncated. Switched to bounded structured summaries; no judgments were based solely on truncated output.

inspection_attempts.attempt: Automatic states sliced as a list
inspection_attempts.result: TypeError: unhashable type: slice; states is a dictionary. Re-read correctly; no judgment written by failed probe.
ValueError: image_rectangle returns box plus clip, not four coordinates. Original helper and error retained as detail-attempt-1 files; corrected helper only.

commands_record: commands.json and saved inspection/generation/validation scripts record the execution. No source/design/expected edits, native executions, SDK acquisition, commits or agent messages occurred.
